fields.statement: Verifier claude-code-ff346ed0 at e292baaae: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(ship-prepush-check|describe-golden)$' PASS. With a scratch build in a hermetic repo, rhiza daemon settings --json lists rhiza.ship.prePushCheck between localGate and generate as {scope: project, default: "", value: "", source: default}; after rhiza daemon set rhiza.ship.prePushCheck 'make self-check' it lists value 'make self-check', source 'git config'. docs/reference/config.md and cli.md carry the key; rhiza docs regenerates them with no diff. CLAUDE.md documents setting it to make self-check for this repo. make self-check here fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered (the builder's landed actor record and the verifier's untracked one), which the run's build/render step rewrites; in a clean worktree at the commit, after rhiza render, rhiza check exits 0 with no docs failure. Nit, not blocking: in internal/api/daemon_settings.go the old generate comment now sits above the prePushCheck comment instead of above the generate entry.
